description: This file defines the WorkWeekDao class which provides database access functionalities for the WorkWeek entity in the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It includes methods for saving a WorkWeek, retrieving a WorkWeek by ID, and checking if a specific date is a non-working day based on the work week configuration.

classes.name: WorkWeekDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling database operations related to the WorkWeek entity within the OrangeHRM leave plugin.

methods.name: saveWorkWeek
methods.description: Persists a WorkWeek entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getWorkWeekById
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkWeek entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Checks if a given date is a non-working day according to the work week configuration, considering full-day or half-day scenarios.
